method: One untimed warm-up per list, one discarded query batch per process; OS cache retained. Raw/VB list order alternates per repetition. Buffers allocated and touched before timing. Memory decoding includes reconstruction and an identical rolling checksum. Cursor scans use production FILE readers, including opening and closing. Complete list scans are a separate workload, not an additive query-time breakdown.
